racing.pairedUnit: seed block with common policy and seed rectangles
racing.promotion: point improvement in C1a or C1b, no credible paired regression in either, and confidence-envelope Pareto non-domination
racing.dominance: one candidate's paired candidate-minus-candidate 95% CRN upper bound is no higher than zero in C1a and C1b, and lower than zero in at least one
racing.candidatePairBootstrap: ordered pairs of complete candidates use lexical candidate-id order, exclude self-pairs, and use bootstrapSeed plus the one-based nested-pair offset
racing.capTieBreak: pre-registered racingSet order after all hard stops and confidence-envelope dominance; no weighted score
stop: C2, aspect-identity or Vow-5 guardrail failure
changed package mechanism did not fire
credible paired regression in C1a or C1b
racing.incremental: each layer inherits the exact previous rectangle and simulates only disjoint added seeds and policies

surrogate.decision: zero model proposals and zero balanced supplement candidates; the inherited four-candidate race is the complete bounded campaign

miniCem.stopRule: after six generations, stop when best-ever improvement across the latest six generations is below 0.01; otherwise maxGen
miniCem.islandSeeds: six common final-layer t1-c000 policy representatives per grid, with candidate-specific frozen start-cell labels
miniCem.commonRandomNumbers: same training seed block within each generation and same validation seeds for every candidate and paired t1-c000

islandSelection.source: final layer t1-c000 raw landscape rows
islandSelection.policyEvidence: per grid and policy, modal frozen cell by row count with lexical cell tie-break; win rate is wins divided by all rows
islandSelection.selection: within each occupied cell choose highest win rate then lowest policy index; order those representatives by win rate descending then cell id and take six; if fewer than six cells are occupied, fill from remaining policies by win rate descending then policy index
islandSelection.candidateStartCell: for each selected common policy, use that candidate's modal frozen cell with lexical cell tie-break

pairedBootstrap.unit: holdout seed block across six islands
pairedBootstrap.pairing: candidate minus t1-c000 on identical island and validation seed

audit.exactCandidates: baseline plus frozen layer3 promoted ids
audit.invocation: python3 -B tools/balance_f0.py --protocol docs/balance/492-tier1-racing-protocol-v1.json --evaluation audit --finalist-audit --audit-finalists FINALIST_SET --only BASELINE,FINALISTS --out AUDIT_DIR

finalistSetSchema.finalists: exact ordered layer3 promoted ids; one or two only

receipt.secondInvocation: fail closed even after a partial first invocation

blockOn: material reversal of final racing breadth or development C3
